name: [OCEAN] Cambria - Creature Survival
desc:
HEAVILY INSPIRED BY SPORE
Community server is being remade 

Build a creature from bones, jaws, limbs and wings, hatch it into a living world, and survive. Eat, drink, hunt, molt and grow from Hatchling to Elder.
Survive storms, hurricanes, tornadoes, wildfires, meteor showers and more. Build a nest, lay eggs and raise your pack.

PC CONTROLS (change any key in Settings > Keys)
WASD move | Shift sprint | Space jump/fly | Ctrl dive | C crouch | Z precise move | Alt free cursor
1-5 attacks | 6 stomp | 7 harden | 8 spit | G roar | F grab | R thrash | T throw | B brace | V lunge
E eat/drink | Q smell | X rest | H burrow | J pit | Y echo | N molt | K nest/lay egg
M map | P pack | I shop | L save & leave | U hide UI

PHONE: everything is on the on-screen buttons.

Please keep in mind the game is a recent release, and is prone to bugs, therefore there are often server restarts

llm.loop: design a creature from bones, jaws and limbs -> hatch in a living world -> eat, drink, hunt, molt and grow from hatchling to elder -> survive disasters, nest and raise a pack
llm.objectives: survive and grow your creature to elder
llm.progression: growth stage, DNA, complexity budget, nest and pack
llm.instructions: build creature, survive hazards, grow, nest
unique: Spore-inspired creature builder inside a survival world
llm.thumbnails: creature in kelp, desert scenes with skeleton creatures
llm.complexity_notes: creature builder, large terrain, weather, ecosystem AI, 200 players
